hook_text: A fish that came back from the dead, dinosaur nests, and a skull more than two million years old. All from South Africa.
clip_script: 1938, East London: fishermen catch a blue fish with leg-like fins. A coelacanth! Thought extinct for 66 million years, still alive. A living fossil! Golden Gate: Massospondylus nests, among the oldest dinosaur nests ever found. Cradle of Humankind: Mrs Ples, Little Foot, Homo naledi. Fossils that help tell the story of humankind. South Africa: one of the richest fossil records on Earth.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa with pins at East London, Golden Gate and the Cradle of Humankind, each with a quick sketch.
mood: Proud and amazed, like a treasure hunt across the country.
pacing: Three pins, three discoveries, one proud ending.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plan a visit to a fossil site near you.
